title: 우편환법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:20:0:00023:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 20 (Standard Reimbursement and its Fee)
(1) A person sending a payment exchange postal item in accordance with Article 25(1)(3) of the Postal Service Act can request the post office to issue a standard reimbursement certificate, indicating that the payment for the postal item has been received from the recipient, and to send it to themselves, after receiving the payment for the postal item. <Amended July 31, 1998>
(2) A person sending a payment exchange postal item in accordance with Article 1(1) must pay the standard reimbursement issuance fee when making the request for reimbursement. <Amended July 31, 1998>
